raws.title: Dinner Is Overdue
raws.logline: A pampered, overweight cat gives his tardy owner an icy reprimand from his window perch.
raws.setting: Sunlit apartment living room beside a dusty wooden windowsill.

character.name: Barnaby
character.look: Seven-year-old rotund ginger tabby cat with wide green eyes, plush striped fur, a notched left ear, and a faded navy collar.

shots.visual: Barnaby sits squarely on the polished wooden windowsill, slowly turning his heavy round head toward the lens.
shots.motion: His head turns deliberately in a smooth arc until his unblinking green eyes lock dead center.

shots.visual: Tight on Barnaby's chubby feline face as his white whiskers twitch forward in stern judgment.
shots.motion: His jowls subtly shift as his mouth delivers the words without breaking intense eye contact.
shots.line: You're late again, human.

raws.title: The Parking Lot
raws.logline: At dawn outside a hospital, a grieving mother and her grown son share a bittersweet laugh over the memory of the father they just lost.
raws.setting: Inside a parked car outside a hospital at cold blue dawn

character.name: Martha
character.look: Sixty-year-old woman with tired graying curls pinned back, soft wrinkled features, pale skin, wearing a dark navy wool coat with a silver dragonfly brooch.

shots.visual: Martha sits in the passenger seat under dim dawn light, gazing out the condensation-fogged car window with a faint, sorrowful smile.
shots.motion: She turns her head slowly toward the driver side as she speaks with quiet affection.
shots.line: Your father would have hated this parking lot.

shots.visual: Her thirty-year-old son behind the steering wheel in a dark jacket smiles through exhausted, red-rimmed eyes as dawn light hits his profile.
shots.motion: He lets out a quiet breath of laughter, shaking his head slightly as he looks over at her.
shots.line: He hated every parking lot, Mom.

raws.title: The Tell

raws.title: Every Sunday Since
raws.logline: Alone on a shadowy stage, an aging violinist speaks to an empty front-row seat before playing their song one more time.
raws.setting: An empty, dimly lit concert hall stage under a single warm overhead spotlight.

character.name: Eleanor
character.look: A seventy-year-old woman with deep laugh lines, silver hair pulled into an elegant chignon, wearing an ivory silk blouse, with a small dark birthmark on her left cheekbone.

shots.visual: Eleanor rests her vintage violin beneath her chin, looking down past the footlights into the dark auditorium with misty eyes.
shots.motion: Slow, steady push-in as she gently tightens her bow and addresses the empty velvet seat.
shots.line: I played this song at our wedding, at your funeral, and every Sunday since, and I will keep playing it until these old hands finally forget how it goes.

shots.visual: Her weathered fingers settle onto the ebony fingerboard as a faint, bittersweet smile touches her lips.
shots.motion: Static hold as she closes her eyes and draws the bow across the first silver string.

raws.title: Graveyard Shift
raws.logline: A sleep-deprived convenience store clerk reaches her breaking point when a customer dumps a pile of loose change onto the counter at dawn.
raws.setting: A dimly lit 24-hour convenience store checkout counter beneath flickering fluorescent strip lights.

character.name: Renee
character.look: Mid-thirties woman with hollow dark-circled eyes, messy auburn bun, faded navy uniform vest over a gray hoodie, and a scarred left eyebrow.

shots.visual: Renee glares straight ahead across the counter, neon reflections glinting in her tired eyes as her thumb drags a sticky coin across the scratched laminate.
shots.motion: Slight handheld drift as she raises her head and exhales a slow, weary breath.
shots.line: It's $4.50, it's 3:15 a.m., and we've been open 24/7 since 1987.

shots.visual: Renee rests her cheek heavily against her palm, staring unblinkingly at the customer while the overhead fluorescent tube buzzes loudly.
shots.motion: Static framing holding locked onto her cold, hollow stare.

character.name: Julian

raws.title: Buried Deep
raws.logline: Drenched in rain beside a freshly dug forest grave, a woman delivers a chilling farewell to what lies beneath.
raws.setting: A sodden forest clearing at dusk during a torrential downpour, edge of pine woods with freshly turned black mud.

character.name: Elena
character.look: Mid-thirties woman with sharp cheekbones, soaked raven hair plastered to her forehead, dark hooded canvas jacket, and a jagged scar across her left eyebrow.

shots.visual: Elena leans heavily on the wooden handle of a mud-caked shovel in the lashing rain, breathing raggedly as she drags a sodden sleeve across her wet forehead.
shots.motion: Camera shivers slightly handheld, holding Elena's heaving chest and intense downward gaze before she slowly lifts her head.

shots.visual: Elena's drenched face fills the vertical frame, rain running in pale tracks through mud splatters on her cheeks as her expression turns ice-cold.
shots.motion: Slow micro-push into her dark, unblinking eyes as water drips from the tip of her nose.
shots.line: Nobody will ever find you here.

raws.title: Silent City Nights
raws.logline: A lonely woman staring at a glowing metropolis feels completely invisible amidst the crowds.

character.name: Maya

raws.title: The Ultimate Bluff
raws.logline: A high-stakes poker player reveals his terrible hand and mocks the dealer after successfully pulling off a brazen bluff.
raws.setting: A dimly lit high-stakes poker room with green felt and smoky air.

character.name: Marcus
character.look: A sharp thirty-five-year-old man with tired brown eyes, slicked-back dark hair, wearing a tailored charcoal suit jacket, with a faded jagged scar across his left cheekbone.

shots.visual: Marcus flips his cards face up onto the green felt, revealing a worthless low-card combination.
shots.motion: Camera tilts up quickly from the cards to catch the sudden grin spreading across his face.

shots.visual: Marcus leans back slowly into his leather chair, steepling his fingers while staring straight ahead at the dealer.
shots.motion: Camera holds steady on his face in tight vertical composition.
shots.line: You actually believed me? [laughs]
